meta.name: agent-role-design
meta.description: Defining what each agent does, knows, and owns in a multi-agent system.

copy.tagline: 定义多智能体系统中每个角色的职责与边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在设计多智能体系统，需要明确每个agent的职责。
copy.tagline_en: Define each agent's role, knowledge, and ownership in a multi-agent system
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a multi-agent system and need to clarify each agent's responsibilities.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会帮你为多智能体系统中的每个智能体定义角色，包括目的、能力、知识范围、权限、边界和成功标准，并遵循单一职责、明确边界等原则。
howto.when: 当你要设计或优化多智能体系统，需要明确每个智能体的职责时，可以要求Claude进行角色设计。

say.text: 为我的多智能体系统设计一个客户支持智能体的角色。
say.note: Claude会生成该智能体的角色卡片。

say.text: 帮我定义两个智能体之间的权限边界。
say.note: Claude会分析冲突并制定规则。

say.text: 我的系统中，智能体A和B功能重叠，如何处理？
say.note: Claude会提供角色冲突解决方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you define roles for each agent in a multi-agent system, including purpose, capabilities, knowledge scope, authority, boundaries, and success criteria, following principles of single responsibility and clear boundaries.
howto.when_en: When you need to design or optimize a multi-agent system and clarify each agent's responsibilities, you can ask Claude for role design.

say_en.text: Design a customer support agent role for my multi-agent system.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the agent's role card.

say_en.text: Define the authority boundaries between two agents.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze conflicts and set rules.

say_en.text: My agents A and B have overlapping functions, how to handle?
